name: Sumitup
reason: No web prototype exists (corrected 2026-10-21): the repo holds one commit from 2025-07-15 with a stock Vite demo frontend and a one-line backend placeholder; the real game is a 222-line pygame desktop prototype (Alpha 0.4a) plus DIFFICULTY_LEVELS.md. Web-first launch with email authentication is abandoned; the MVP is free, ad-supported, single-player and mobile-leaning, with no backend. ICR (2026-10-21) verdict: Mostly buildable from internal capability; genuine gaps are mobile packaging, an ad SDK and a store account; $25-40 unavoidable spend to first revenue; 1,000-user goal retained as a retention test, not a revenue target.
